answer: Pair every identity with a random stranger each epoch and make the pair co-author one short answer in alternating turns, negotiating a shared conclusion. A lone operator scripting fifty faces can fake solo text, but cannot genuinely negotiate with itself fifty times at once: the two sides echo, the shared pigment of phrasing shows through the umber drafting, and the joint horizon collapses into one voice. Real collaboration, not solo output, becomes the scarce proof.
